title: Computer Terminology And Fundamental
definition: Computers are programmable electronic devices that process input data into meaningful output information through a sequence of arithmetic and logical operations governed by stored instructions (software). The fundamental architecture revolves around the von Neumann model, featuring a Central Processing Unit (CPU), memory, input/output mechanisms, and secondary storage.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Civil Services Prelims (General Science and Technology section targeting digital literacy, hardware/software fundamentals, emerging tech terms) and Mains (GS Paper III: IT, Computers, Cyber Security, E-Governance applications).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Computer Terminology And Fundamental.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of electronics and digital logic
Familiarity with everyday digital devices and binary data concepts
